label: PF Backlog 549
title: C17: security_impact review decision on every work item + advisory validator (per-work security impact analysis)
body:
## Problem / why
Every change already records `api_impact` and `dashboard_impact` REVIEW decisions, but NOTHING records a
**security impact**. Security work is therefore not surfaced at the point a change is groomed/planned, so it is
caught late (if at all).

## Goal & value
Make "security impact for every work" first-class and enforced at the same boundary as api/dashboard impact:
every item records a `security_impact` decision; an advisory validator surfaces gaps.

## In scope
- `security_impact` field on BacklogItem: `{needs_security: bool, tier: "S0".."S6"|null, controls: [..], reason: str}`.
- `core/backlog.py:set_security_impact(scope, project, eid, needs_security, tier, controls, reason)` (single writer).
- `core/backlog.py:security_impact_warnings()` advisory (mirror `api_impact_warnings()`); wired into `wired_audit`.
- Update path validates the field type fail-closed (like other structured fields).

## Out of scope
- The guidelines content (C18) and the implementing agent (C19).

## Acceptance criteria (G/W/T)
- Given an open item with no `security_impact` decision, when `wired_audit` runs, then a non-fatal advisory names it.
- Given `needs_security=true` with no controls listed, then the validator flags it (unknown => surfaces).
- Given `set_security_impact(...)`, then the item persists the decision and `wired_audit` no longer flags it.

## Data model (what is stored, where, owner)
`items/<ID>.json` -> `security_impact` (owner `core/backlog.py`; same store as `api_impact`/`dashboard_impact`).

## API contract
POST /api/v1/backlog/items/{item_id}/security-impact  (records the decision via core/backlog.py)

## Dependencies & links (by id)
EPIC BI-PF-1202; C13 BI-PF-1215 (profile); C14 BI-PF-1216 (gates). Pattern source: BI-PF-1171 (api_impact E9).

## Verification / test plan
Unit: set + validator (missing / needs_security-without-controls / recorded). Wired into `wired_audit`.

dashboard_impact.reason: security impact per item is operator-visible in the backlog/orchestrator UI.
